# Alka Traders

> Alka Traders is a global supplier of marine spares, industrial equipment, surplus machinery, and emergency procurement parts. Based in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India.

Alka Traders serves ship owners, fleet managers, procurement teams, and industrial buyers worldwide with fast delivery of OEM and aftermarket parts for marine, oil & gas, power generation, manufacturing, and chemical processing industries.

## Key Services

- [Marine Equipment & Ship Spares](https://alkatraders.co/shop) - GPS navigators, VHF radios, radar, ECDIS, hydraulic motors, lifeboat mechanisms, fire detection systems
- [Electrical Automation](https://alkatraders.co/products?category=electrical) - VFDs, PLCs, contactors, circuit breakers from ABB, Siemens, Schneider
- [Hydraulic Systems](https://alkatraders.co/products?category=hydraulic) - Axial piston pumps, cylinders, steering gear actuators from Parker, Bosch Rexroth
- [Emergency Procurement](https://alkatraders.co/emergency) - 24/7 urgent parts sourcing with 18-hour delivery record
- [Request for Quote](https://alkatraders.co/rfq) - Submit RFQ for any marine or industrial part

## Product Categories

- Marine Equipment (ship spares, navigation, engine parts)
- Electrical Automation (VFDs, PLCs, switchgear)
- Hydraulic Systems (pumps, cylinders, motors)
- Pneumatic Systems (valves, cylinders, air preparation)
- Industrial Spare Parts (bearings, couplings, sensors)
- Surplus Inventory (unused/refurbished equipment)
- Lifting & Handling (cranes, hoists, rigging)
- Tools & Equipment (industrial tools, power tools)
- Safety Equipment (PPE, fall protection, fire safety)

## Key Brands

ABB, Siemens, Parker Hannifin, Bosch Rexroth, Schneider Electric, Danfoss, Honeywell, Emerson, Festo, SMC, Grundfos, Atlas Copco, Wärtsilä, Alfa Laval, Kongsberg, SKF, IFM, Pepperl+Fuchs
